changes.zh: 首个公开发布版本：单文件 Markdown 编辑器，加工作区知识库（索引、双链、标签、图谱、版本历史）。
changes.en: First public release: the single-file Markdown editor plus the workspace knowledge base (index, backlinks, tags, graph, version history).

changes.zh: 新增 PDF 阅读器：连续 / 单页翻页、缩放与缩略图大纲。
changes.en: Add a PDF reader with continuous and single-page layouts, zoom, and an outline.

changes.zh: 新增图片查看器，以及「在工作区中打开」。
changes.en: Add an image viewer and open-in-workspace.

changes.zh: 裸启动直接进入工作区模式，不再先落在轻量模式。
changes.en: Open workspace mode on a bare launch instead of landing in lightweight mode.

changes.zh: 文件树图标按类型区分，并修好新建文件后的选中落点。
changes.en: Split tree icons by file type and fix the selection after creating a file.

changes.zh: 更新判定改用 isUpdateAvailable，不再拿版本号比字符串 —— 本地领先于远端时不再误报有新版本。
changes.en: Judge updates by isUpdateAvailable rather than comparing version strings, so a local build ahead of the release no longer reports a phantom update.

changes.zh: 新增编辑器工具栏与格式动作。
changes.en: Add the editor toolbar and its format actions.

changes.zh: 标签页栏常驻显示，编辑器工具栏移到它下方。
changes.en: Always show the tab bar and move the editor toolbar below it.

changes.zh: 每个标签页各自记住滚动位置，切换回来不再跳回顶部。
changes.en: Keep a separate scroll position per tab instead of jumping back to the top.

changes.zh: 新增用户主题目录：自定义主题以文件形式存在 `~/.nexus/themes/`，可以直接编辑、备份、分享。
changes.en: Add the user theme directory: custom themes live as files under `~/.nexus/themes/`, so they can be edited, backed up and shared directly.

changes.zh: 设置页新增内置能力启停开关。
changes.en: Add built-in capability toggles in settings.

changes.zh: 插件面板显示提取失败、来源与停用状态。
changes.en: Show extraction failures, sources and disabled state in the plugins panel.

changes.zh: 修好「重建索引」在磁盘内容没变化时清空附件正文的问题。
changes.en: Stop rebuilding the index from clearing attachment text when nothing changed on disk.

changes.zh: 新增更新中心：启动时自动检查更新，在独立窗口里看更新日志与下载进度，可以跳过某一版或稍后再提醒。
changes.en: Add the update center: check for updates on launch, then read what changed and follow the download in its own window, with skip and remind-me-later.

changes.zh: 更新日志支持中英双语，远端、随包与 GitHub 发布说明三层回落。
changes.en: Serve the changelog in Chinese and English, falling back across the remote copy, the bundled copy and the GitHub release notes.

changes.zh: 设置页新增「关于」分组，版本号与更新入口从「通用」迁出。
changes.en: Add an About group in settings and move the version and the update entry point out of General.

changes.zh: 新增日志：应用运行期间发生的事会写进日志文件，报问题时可以把它附上。设置里能调记录的详细程度，也能直接打开日志目录。
changes.en: Add logging: what happens while the app runs is written to a log file you can attach to a bug report. Settings can raise or lower how much is recorded, and open the log folder.

changes.zh: 工具栏的标题不再是下拉：正文与标题 1–6 各占一格，点一下就改型，当前停在哪一级一眼能看出来。
changes.en: Headings in the toolbar are no longer a dropdown: paragraph and headings 1–6 each get their own button, one click to apply, and the current level is visible at a glance.

changes.zh: 外部改动与本地改动可以逐块合并了：有共同祖先时逐块给出建议，四选（保留本地 / 采用磁盘 / 两侧都留 / 丢弃）后走正常保存路径。
changes.en: Merge external and local edits block by block: when a common ancestor exists the app suggests a choice for each block, and the result goes through the normal save path.

changes.zh: 新增 `==高亮==` 行内标记。
changes.en: Add the `==highlight==` inline mark.

changes.zh: 修好 CRLF 文档里空行高度塌成 0、行号挤在一起的问题。
changes.en: Fix blank lines in CRLF documents collapsing to zero height, which made the gutter numbers pile up.

changes.zh: 修好嵌套列表之后的块被重复写一遍，以及带脚注定义的笔记被解析成坏链接的问题。
changes.en: Fix blocks after nested lists being written twice, and footnotes being parsed into broken links.

changes.zh: 标签栏末尾新增「＋」按钮，用来新建未命名文档（等同 Ctrl+N）。
changes.en: Add a "+" button at the end of the tab bar to create a new untitled document (same as Ctrl+N).

changes.zh: 标签超出标签栏宽度时可纵向滚轮横滚，被挤出去的一侧渐隐提示。
changes.en: Tabs that overflow the tab bar can be scrolled with the vertical mouse wheel, and the clipped side fades out.

changes.zh: 「文件」菜单新增「打开文件夹…」与「打开最近的工作区」，不用重启就能换一个工作区；命令面板里也有「打开文件夹…」。
changes.en: Add "Open Folder…" and "Open Recent Workspace" to the File menu, so you can switch workspaces without restarting. The command palette gets "Open Folder…" too.

changes.zh: 记住最近打开的 8 个工作区，最近的排在前面；已经不在磁盘上的那些（比如拔掉的移动盘）不会出现在菜单里，启动时也会跳过它们继续往下找。
changes.en: Remember the last 8 workspaces, most recent first. Ones that are no longer on disk — an unplugged drive, say — are left out of the menu and skipped on launch.

changes.zh: 工具栏「切换到富文本 / 切换到源码」的提示改成按平台显示真实快捷键 —— Windows 上是 Ctrl+M，不再显示按不下去的 Mod-M；用户在设置里改绑或取消绑定后，提示跟着变。
changes.en: The toolbar tooltip for switching between Visual and Source now shows the real shortcut for the platform — Ctrl+M on Windows instead of a non-functional Mod-M. It follows rebinding or unbinding done in Settings.

changes.zh: 设置窗口不再记住上次停在哪一组：打开就是外观分组，或从插件面板「在设置中管理」跳过来的那一组。切分组仍然当场生效，只是不跨窗口保留。
changes.en: The Settings window no longer remembers which group you were last on: it opens on Appearance, or on the group requested by “Manage in Settings” from the plugins panel. Switching groups still works instantly — it just is not kept across windows.

changes.zh: 富文本模式下，`\*` 这样的转义序列现在只显示转义后的字符 —— 写 30\*30 看到的就是 30*30，反斜杠不再泄露。光标移进转义符时会还原成 `\*`，就地可改；这只是显示层，文档内容一个字节都没动。
changes.en: In Visual mode, escaped characters like `\*` now render as the character alone — typing 30\*30 shows 30*30 and the backslash no longer leaks through. Moving the cursor onto the escape reveals `\*` for editing. This is display-only: your document is unchanged.

changes.zh: 工作区侧栏头部多了一枚「切换工作区」按钮：点开是「切换工作区…」加最近打开过的工作区列表（当前所在的根打 ✓）。以前换工作区只能走文件菜单或命令面板，侧栏里没有任何入口。
changes.en: The workspace sidebar header now has a “Switch workspace” button: it opens “Switch workspace…” plus the list of recently opened workspaces, with your current root checked. Switching used to be possible only from the File menu or the command palette.

changes.zh: 重开软件时自动恢复上次的工作区和开着的文档：通用设置里新增「启动时恢复上次打开的文档」（默认开启），关掉它就只恢复工作区、不恢复标签页。恢复出的活动文档会在折叠的文件树里自动展开所在目录并选中，不会「文档开着却在树里看不见」。
changes.en: Relaunching now restores your last workspace and the documents you had open. A new “Restore documents on launch” setting (on by default) lives in General; turn it off to restore only the workspace and no tabs. The restored active document reveals and selects itself in the file tree, so an open document is never invisible in the tree.

changes.zh: 文件树重开后默认全部折叠，第一屏只列顶层；恢复的文档仍会自动展开并选中。目录多的工作区启动时不再一屏铺满。
changes.en: The file tree now starts fully collapsed, showing only top-level entries. Restored documents still reveal and select themselves. Workspaces with many directories no longer open to a wall of files.

changes.zh: 点左侧栏的「图谱」图标，图谱现在占满编辑区：编辑区连同标签栏、工具栏一起让位，侧栏同时留在文件树上。在图谱里点节点打开文档、或再点一次「图谱」图标，都会退回编辑区。窄侧栏里展不开的图终于有地方铺开了。
changes.en: Clicking Graph in the activity bar now expands the graph into the main content area: the editor, tab bar, and toolbar step aside while the sidebar stays on the file tree. Opening a document from the graph — or clicking Graph again — takes you back to the editor. The graph finally has room to spread out.

changes.zh: 图谱占用编辑区期间，左侧栏现在整体隐藏，只留图谱一屏；退出图谱（打开文档或再点一次「图谱」图标）时侧栏自动回到文件树。以往图谱与文件树并排，两边都挤在一千多像素里。
changes.en: The sidebar now hides entirely while the graph owns the editor area, leaving the graph a full screen. Exiting the graph (opening a document or clicking the “Graph” icon again) brings the file tree back. Previously the graph and file tree split the width between them.

changes.zh: 修上一条留下的白边：图谱占用编辑区时，侧栏只藏了内容，那一条两百多像素的空白仍在原地，图谱并没有真正铺满。现在连面板宽度与拖拽把手一起收起，退出图谱时平滑地还回来。
changes.en: Fixes the blank strip left by the previous change: hiding the sidebar's contents kept its 240px column in place, so the graph never really filled the window. The panel width and resize handle now collapse along with it, and slide back when you leave the graph.

changes.zh: PDF 阅读器多了「拖动」工具：以前指针恒为文本选择，一张比窗口大的表格想挪一下看别处，只能去够滚动条。现在工具栏上「选择文本 / 拖动页面」两个按钮可切换，拖动模式下按住左键就能把页面推着走，光标也跟着变成手型；切到拖动会顺手清掉已有选区，免得底部那条引用栏一直挂着。
changes.en: The PDF viewer gained a pan tool: the pointer used to be locked to text selection, so moving around a table wider than the window meant reaching for the scrollbar. The toolbar now has a select/pan pair — in pan mode you drag the page with the left button and the cursor turns into a hand. Switching to pan also clears any existing selection, so the citation bar does not linger.

changes.zh: PDF 阅读器的工具栏按钮从文字换成了图标（导航、上一页/下一页、缩小/放大、适合宽度、连续/单页）。九个汉字按钮排下来把工具栏撑得很长，而这些本来都是公认的手势。
changes.en: The PDF toolbar buttons are now icons instead of words — navigation, page turning, zoom, fit width, and the single/continuous toggle. Nine word buttons stretched the bar; these are gestures people already know.

changes.zh: PDF 阅读器底部那条文件名去掉了：文件名在标签页上已经有了，省下的高度留给正文。
changes.en: Removed the file-name bar at the bottom of the PDF viewer — the name is already on the tab, and the space goes to the document instead.

changes.zh: 保存文件不再弹「文件已被外部删除或移动」。原子写入是两步 rename —— 旧文件改名做备份、临时文件改名就位，第二步带着目标文件名；以前目录监听按事件类型转发，就把它当成了外部删除。现在只看路径上还有没有文件，不去猜底层报的是哪种事件。
changes.en: Saving a file no longer reports "this file was deleted or moved externally". An atomic write is two renames — the old file aside as a backup, the temp file into place — and the second one carries the target filename, which the directory watcher used to forward by event type as a deletion. Event type is now decided by whether the path still holds a file, not by which fs event happened to arrive.

changes.zh: 文件确实被外部删掉时，横幅上现在有「重新读取」和「写回原位置」两个出口，不再只剩「另存为」。重新读取会把盘上的版本拉回来 —— 文件其实回来了的话自动转去冲突横幅，那里才有「合并…」；写回原位置把缓冲区重新写成文件，走已有保存那条路，串行化和错误提示都是现成的。
changes.en: When a file really is deleted externally, the banner now offers Re-read and Write Back instead of Save As alone. Re-read pulls the on-disk version back — and if the file has quietly come back, the app moves on to the conflict banner, where merging lives. Write Back recreates the file from the buffer through the existing save path, so serialisation and error reporting come for free.

changes.zh: 设置里新增「打开 Markdown 时的模式」：始终富文本、始终源码、记住上次模式，默认始终富文本。选「记住」时每次切换都会记下来，下次打开同一份文档就落在上次那个模式上。
changes.en: A new setting, "Mode when opening Markdown", with three choices: always rich text (the default), always source, and remember last used. With Remember, every switch is recorded, and the next document opens in whichever mode you left.

changes.zh: 侧栏搜索的多文件命中现在带上下文：每条结果下面多一行片段，命中词前后各取一段并高亮它，比原来只有一行文件名好认得多；条目之间也加上了分隔线。片段里的空白严格一对一折叠成空格，高亮位置因此不会错位。
changes.en: Multi-file search hits in the sidebar now carry context: each entry gains a snippet line with the text around the match highlighted, which beats a bare list of file names, and entries are separated by a divider. Whitespace in the snippet is collapsed strictly one-for-one, so the highlight never lands off by a character.

changes.zh: 编辑器内的查找/替换面板改成了编辑器右上角的悬浮卡片，不再是一条横贯编辑器顶部、会把正文往下挤的长条 —— 版式照 VS Code：一行放查找框、匹配计数、上下跳转、三个开关和关闭，替换行由最左的箭头展开。卡片浮在正文之上，正文一动不动，右侧也留出了滚动条的位置。
changes.en: The in-editor find/replace panel is now a floating card in the editor's top-right corner instead of a full-width strip above the editor that pushed the text down. The layout follows VS Code: one row holds the field, the match counter, prev/next, the three toggles and close, with the replace row opened by the arrow at the left edge. The card floats over the document, which no longer shifts, and it keeps clear of the scrollbar on the right.

changes.zh: 编辑器内的查找/替换面板以前只有英文，现在整套文案跟随界面语言，而且切换语言时面板当场就换、不必关掉重开；查找和替换也拆成两个命令入口、各带各的快捷键，替换不再藏在查找面板的第二行里。
changes.en: The in-editor find/replace panel was English-only; its whole vocabulary now follows the interface language, and it retranslates on the spot when you switch languages — no need to close and reopen it. Find and replace are also split into two commands with separate shortcuts, so replace no longer hides on the panel's second row.

changes.zh: 查找面板现在显示「当前第几处/共几处」，跳到下一处时数字跟着走；一处都没命中时直接写「无结果」，不再是一片沉默。三个开关（区分大小写、正则、全字匹配）从占宽的文字改成 Aa / .* / ab 图标，勾选状态一眼看得见，含义挪到无障碍标签上。替换行默认收起，用面板最左的箭头或「替换」命令展开。
changes.en: The find panel now shows which match you are on out of how many, and the number follows as you step through. When nothing matches it says so outright instead of staying silent. The three toggles (match case, regexp, whole word) became Aa / .* / ab icons, so their on-state is visible at a glance, with the meaning moved to accessible labels. The replace row starts collapsed, opened by the arrow at the panel's left edge or by the Replace command.

changes.zh: 选中一段文字后，全文其余相同的地方会垫上底色，方便一眼看清这个词还在哪儿出现过。
changes.en: Selecting some text now tints every other occurrence of it in the document, so you can see at a glance where else the word appears.

changes.zh: 富文本模式下搜索会漏掉渲染成卡片的文字（比如 [[双向链接]] 的内容）：面板明明报了一处命中，正文里却一处高亮都没有。原因是这类文字整段被卡片替换掉了，编辑器的高亮落不到它上面。现在由卡片自己把命中底色画出来。
changes.en: In rich text mode, searching used to miss text that renders as a card — the contents of a [[wikilink]], for instance. The panel would report a match while the document showed no highlight at all, because that whole span is replaced by the card and the editor's own highlight has nowhere to land. The card now paints the match highlight itself.

changes.zh: CI 编译期间也能在应用内看到最新版的更新内容：上界改判 git tag，不再等 release 发布。
changes.en: See the latest release notes while CI is still building: the changelog ceiling now keys off git tags instead of waiting for a release.

changes.zh: 设置窗口默认打开「通用」分组，不再停在外观。
changes.en: The settings window now opens on General instead of Appearance.

changes.zh: 图片查看器工具栏换成图标按钮，与 PDF 阅读器对齐。
changes.en: The image viewer toolbar now uses icon buttons, matching the PDF reader.

changes.zh: 编辑器、PDF、图片三处工具栏统一为同一套栏容器与按钮外观。
changes.en: The editor, PDF and image toolbars now share one toolbar container and button style.

changes.zh: 更新内容只列真的发布了、能下载的版本。CI 还在编译、安装包还没生成时，那一版不再出现（此前会显示出来，用户读完却下载不到）。
changes.en: Release notes now list only versions that are actually published and downloadable. While a build is still running there is nothing to download, so that version no longer appears.

changes.zh: 图谱取数失败时不再画成一张空图。此前索引查询出错和「工作区里一篇文档都没有」长得一模一样，用户只会以为自己的笔记丢了。
changes.en: A failed graph load no longer looks like an empty graph. A broken index query and a workspace with no documents used to render identically, so it looked like the notes were gone.

changes.zh: 图谱里单击节点改为**选中**并弹出详情条（类型、入链 / 出链、打开 / 新建），双击才打开文档 —— 以前点一下就会被踢出图谱。
changes.en: Clicking a node in the graph now selects it and shows a detail bar (type, incoming/outgoing links, open/create); a double click opens the document. A single click used to throw you out of the graph.

changes.zh: 新增「断链」清单：列出所有写了、但工作区里还没有对应文档的链接，以及每条被哪几篇引用 —— 图上那几个红点现在可以逐条枚举了。
changes.en: New 'Dead links' list: every link that points at a document that does not exist yet, together with the documents that reference it. Those red dots on the canvas can now be enumerated.

changes.zh: 图谱为空时给出下一步动作（新建文档 / 打开搜索），并说明「什么算孤立」的规则，而不是只留一片空白。
changes.en: An empty graph now offers a next step (create a document / open search) and explains what counts as an orphan, instead of leaving a blank canvas.

changes.zh: 长文本按字素簇截断。此前 emoji、组合音标会被从中间切开，显示成一个乱码方块。
changes.en: Long text is now clipped by grapheme cluster. Emoji and combining marks used to be cut in half and rendered as a replacement-character box.

changes.zh: 「未链接提及」对中文改用真正的词边界判断，像「记笔记」这种动宾短语里不再把「笔记」误报成一处提及。（已知残留：「笔记本」这类复合词仍会命中。）
changes.en: 'Unlinked mentions' now uses real word boundaries for Chinese, so a term is no longer reported inside a verb-object phrase such as 记笔记. (Known limitation: it still matches inside compounds such as 笔记本.)

changes.zh: 图谱标签加了底色与描边，压在线上的时候也读得清；标签数量随缩放变化 —— 缩小只留活跃文档与前几条，放大才铺开。
changes.en: Graph labels now have a background and an outline so they stay readable on top of edges, and how many are drawn follows the zoom level — zoomed out keeps only the active document and a few more, zoomed in shows the full budget.

changes.zh: 图谱头部同时显示节点数与连线数。只有节点数的话，二十个点可能是二十条线，也可能一条都没有。
changes.en: The graph header now shows both the node and the link count. With only a node count, twenty nodes could mean twenty links or none at all.

changes.zh: 孤儿与枢纽清单改成两行卡片：第一行文件名、第二行相对路径。此前只有一行路径，深目录里的文件扫起来很费劲。
changes.en: The orphans and hubs lists now use two-line cards — file name on the first line, relative path on the second. A single path line was hard to scan in deep folders.

changes.zh: 图谱的分区配色从 6 色扩到 8 色。顶层目录多的时候，图例不再出现「颜色对不上画布」的那一行。
changes.en: The graph cluster palette grew from 6 to 8 colours, so the legend no longer contains entries whose colour does not match the canvas.

changes.zh: 「当前文档」这个范围用不了的时候（当前文档还没进索引，或它的类型被筛选隐藏了）不再「按了没反应」：按钮会禁用并说明原因，图退回整个工作区。
changes.en: The 'Current document' scope no longer silently does nothing when it cannot be honoured (the document is not indexed yet, or its type is hidden by the filter). The button is disabled with an explanation, and the graph falls back to the whole workspace.

changes.zh: 枢纽榜的「被引用 N 次」与孤儿清单现在和画布上真的画出来的边完全一致：同一篇里用两种写法指向同一目标只算一次，只自引的文档在清单和画布上都被当成孤立。
changes.en: The 'referenced N times' count in the hubs list and the orphans list now agree with the edges actually drawn on the canvas: two different spellings of the same target inside one document count once, and a document that only links to itself is treated as isolated in both the list and the canvas.

changes.zh: 图谱里选中一个文档节点，详情条现在还会给出它的类型和标签。此前只有路径与入链/出链数，想知道「这篇归在哪儿」得先回去打开它。
changes.en: Selecting a document node in the graph now also shows its type and its tags in the detail bar. Before this only the path and the in/out link counts were there, so finding out where a document belonged meant opening it first.

changes.zh: 图谱左下角的图例有了可见标题（「目录」）。此前那里只有一列彩色方块和目录名，光看屏幕读不出那些颜色是「按顶层目录分区」的意思。
changes.en: The graph legend in the bottom-left corner now has a visible title ('Folders'). It used to be a column of coloured squares and folder names with nothing on screen saying those colours stand for top-level folders.

changes.zh: 图谱里新出现的节点会先散开一圈光晕再落定。在一张已经有几十个点的图上，「只是变大 + 淡入」太不显眼 —— 而出生动画的意义正是告诉你什么变了。
changes.en: A node that appears in the graph now expands a halo before it settles. On a canvas that already holds dozens of points, 'grows and fades in' was too easy to miss — and the whole point of the birth animation is to tell you what changed.

changes.zh: 从图谱点开一篇文档时，会落在它的**代表性锚点**那一节，而不是文档开头 —— `[[dma#性能]]` 这类链接早就写明了用户关心哪一节。同一篇被多处引用、锚点各不相同时取出现最多的那个（平局按字典序，所以落点是确定的，不会两次打开跳到不同标题）。没有任何带锚点的引用时，照旧落在开头。
changes.en: Opening a document from the graph now lands on its representative anchor section instead of the top of the file — a link such as `[[dma#性能]]` already says which section matters. When a document is referenced with several different anchors, the most frequent one wins (ties break deterministically, so two sessions never land on different headings). With no anchored reference at all it still opens at the top.

changes.zh: 工作区文件树**空白处**右键现在有菜单了：新建文件 / 新建文件夹 · 全部展开 / 收起 · 显示图片 · 重新扫描工作区。在此之前右键空白处**什么都不发生** —— Electron 默认不弹原生菜单，那不是「回落到系统菜单」，是真的没反应。新建落在**工作区根**（不跟着选中项走），「显示图片」是带勾选态的开关而不是把文案在「显示 / 隐藏」之间翻转。
changes.en: Right-clicking empty space in the workspace file tree now opens a menu: new file / new folder · expand or collapse all · show images · rescan workspace. Nothing used to happen there at all — Electron shows no native menu by default, so it was not "falling back to the system menu", it was silence. Creation targets the workspace root rather than the current selection, and "Show images" is a real checkbox instead of a label that flips between show and hide.

changes.zh: 右键菜单支持**灰掉的项**（点不动、回车不触发、键盘上下键跳过它），一个动作都没有的菜单也不再画出一个空框 —— 补出来的目录行（磁盘列举里缺了那一层）以前会弹出一个什么都没有的方框。
changes.en: Context menus now support disabled items (not clickable, Enter does nothing, arrow keys skip them), and a menu with no actions no longer renders as an empty box — a synthesised folder row used to open a blank rectangle.

changes.zh: **标签页**右键现在有菜单了：关闭 · 关闭其他 · 关闭右侧标签页 · 全部关闭 · 在文件树中定位。在此之前右键标签也是**什么都不发生**。前三项按选区灰着（「关闭其他」在只剩一条时、「关闭右侧」在最后一条上），而不是忽有忽无 —— 灰着的一格比消失的一项好解释。关闭走的还是 `Ctrl+W` 那条路径，所以「有路径的先落盘、未命名的先问」这条规则不会分叉。「在文件树中定位」只在**这一篇确实在当前工作区里**时给：不在树里的文件定位不了，给一个按下去没反应的项比不给更糟。
changes.en: Right-clicking a **tab** now opens a menu: close · close others · close tabs to the right · close all · reveal in file tree. Right-clicking a tab used to do nothing at all. The first three grey out according to the selection (close others when it is the only tab, close to the right on the last one) rather than appearing and disappearing — a greyed-out row is easier to explain than a missing one. Closing still goes through the same path as Ctrl+W, so the rule about saving files with a path and asking about unnamed ones does not fork. Reveal in file tree is only offered when the document is actually inside the current workspace: a file outside the tree cannot be located, and an entry that does nothing is worse than no entry.

changes.zh: **编辑器正文**右键现在有菜单了：剪切 / 复制 / 粘贴 / 全选 · **格式**（二级）· 插入链接 / 查找 / 替换。这是「右键 / 快捷键 / 工具栏用同一组命令」的第三个入口 —— 点「格式 → 粗体」和按 `Ctrl+B`、点工具栏那枚按钮走的是同一条命令，不是第二份实现。**没有选中文字时，格式子菜单里不给行内格式**（粗体 / 斜体 / 删除线 / 高亮 / 行内代码 / 清除格式）—— 它们本来就要求有选区，列出来只会是按下去没反应的六项。右键打在正文下方那块空白上也照常弹：那块空白在视觉上就是「纸」。只读文档里写动作灰着、复制与查找照常可用。
changes.en: Right-clicking in the **editor body** now opens a menu: cut / copy / paste / select all · **Format** (a submenu) · insert link / find / replace. This is the third entry point for "right-click, shortcut, and toolbar run the same command" — Format → Bold goes through the exact same command as Ctrl+B and the toolbar button, not a second implementation. With no text selected, the format submenu omits the inline formats (bold / italic / strikethrough / highlight / inline code / clear formatting) because they require a selection; listing them would only produce six entries that do nothing. Right-clicking the empty area below the text works too — that area reads as the page. In read-only documents the writing actions are greyed out while copy and find stay available.

changes.zh: 右键菜单支持**二级子菜单**（悬浮或按右键方向键展开，方向键进出、`Escape` 先收子菜单再关菜单），右边放不下时**往左翻**而不是跑到屏幕外。菜单同时有了高度上限与内部滚动 —— 在此之前一份长菜单会被视口裁掉，下面那几项永远看不到。
changes.en: Context menus now support **one level of submenus** (open on hover or with the right arrow key, navigate in and out with the arrow keys, and Escape closes the submenu before the menu), and a submenu flips to the left instead of running off screen when there is no room on the right. Menus also gained a height cap with internal scrolling — before this, a long menu was clipped by the viewport and the bottom entries could never be reached.

changes.zh: 工作区文件树右键现在能**复制 / 剪切 / 粘贴 / 复制到… / 移动到…** 了，文件与文件夹都行，文件夹按整棵子树递归。**剪切不落盘** —— 真正搬动发生在粘贴那一刻，被剪的那几行会变灰（那是剪切唯一的可见反馈，否则点完菜单屏幕上一个像素都不变）。粘贴用**内部剪贴板**而不是系统剪贴板：系统剪贴板里没有「剪切了、等着粘贴」这个状态，走它就只能靠猜。重名**自动加序号**（`笔记.md` → `笔记-1.md`，序号插在扩展名之前），永不覆盖。移动会**先摆出「要改哪些别人的文档」再让你点头**：指向被搬走那份的引用会跟着改（可以在设置里关掉），而**被搬走那份自己的相对链接恒跟着改**（不改就是它自己断了）。复制不改别人的文档，所以直接做完。搬完给一条回执说出落点。
changes.en: The workspace file tree now supports **copy / cut / paste / copy to… / move to…** for both files and folders, with folders handled recursively. **Cutting does not touch the disk** — the actual move happens at paste time, and the cut rows grey out (that is the only visible feedback for a cut; without it nothing on screen changes when you pick the menu item). Paste uses an **internal clipboard** rather than the system one: the OS clipboard has no "cut, waiting to be pasted" state, so relying on it would mean guessing. Name collisions **get a numeric suffix** (`note.md` → `note-1.md`, inserted before the extension) and never overwrite. Moving first **shows which other documents would be rewritten and asks before doing it**: references pointing at the moved item are updated along with it (this can be turned off in settings), while the moved item's **own relative links are always rebased** (leaving them alone is how it breaks itself). Copying leaves other documents untouched, so it just runs. A receipt reports where things landed.
